interpretation_limits: Fixed1024 repeatedly drives adaptive weights and is a training feedback panel, not an independent validation set. Exposure-outcome correlation is confounded by deliberate selection of low/regressing scenes.
The additional3072 are feedback-unseen; some were sampled by uniform training. Stratify by exact exposure instead of calling every extra scene training-unseen.
Observed full NAVTEST scores are for checkpoint comparison; no NAVTEST token/score enters training scene selection.
Stage9 census is predetermined for9k→10k but is not proof that10k feedback/evaluation is complete.
Different arms deliberately sample different training distributions. Their SDE reward/clip/zero-PG summaries are process diagnostics, not matched generalization comparisons.

next_experiment_priority.decision_rule: 若ADAPT只在反馈面板优于FULL而在额外3072尤其2820未训练场景中落后，则为反馈特化证据；若额外场景也改善则不能仅凭重复曝光否定adaptive。
next_experiment_priority.why: 用同预算/同ODE协议拆旧1024与新增3072，按实际曝光、physical-log和N_log/n_log权重分析；新增3072永不进入当前反馈。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: 到9k实际18000曝光中1024面板占10410=57.83%；8rank fresh日志与全部已完成stage census完全匹配。整体仅覆盖8034/103288=7.78%。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 固定反馈面板存在强烈曝光集中，尚不能由其分数恢复推断泛化改善。
面板回升有描述性证据，但既非单调，也未超过IL基线。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: 225个曝光至少17次的面板场景平均27.7次，从1k到9k回升1.3239，但仍比IL低1.5859；303个从未训练的面板场景原本接近满分。最多曝光的两场景108/107次始终ODE0，共占215/18000=1.19%。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 高曝光困难场景有局部恢复，但选择偏差很强，不能做曝光导致改善的因果判断。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: 到9k其中2833=92.22%完全没有训练曝光，10k已封存census推定仍2820=91.80%；其全部都未用于自适应反馈选样。应分feedback-unseen与实际training-unseen，而非笼统称独立heldout。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 额外3072场景诊断是当前最有价值的数据决策证据。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: 5k ADAPT90.7393 vs FULL90.5822高0.1571；尚无完整ADAPT10k Test。FULL5k→10k90.5822→91.0195，HARD90.8544→90.7356。应以同预算4k FULL/ADAPT与后续Test共同判断。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 现有Test只支持自适应小幅有希望，不能确认固定面板集中已经过拟合。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: 正常native1000约40min，反馈/续训约7min，再加约1.5min模型准备；历史1k旧全局门槛多等约27.6min已修，8k额外拥塞含6轮确证prechild75 known-owner拒绝，不能拿异常总等待代表算法内生代价。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 反馈有稳定成本，也有可修复的运营异常，两者应分开。

research_conclusions_zh.evidence: fresh集合zero_PG比例ADAPT0.994%、FULL0.720%、HARD0.200%；不同数据选样的训练reward均值不可直接排序泛化能力。
research_conclusions_zh.finding: 零方差/无策略梯度不是目前数据训练的主要浪费来源。
